description: Changing corner radius and floating to their endpoint values immediately recalculates the panel mask and dock surface margin.

assertions.comment: The actual capture path of the unnamed panel body immediately reflects corner radius 0 as square corners
The panel mask of the unnamed shadow shader also uses corner radius 0
Disabling floating removes the 8px bottom margin and reduces dock surface height from 108px to 100px
Raising corner radius to the maximum 24 immediately increases the panel body curvature
The shadow shader’s rounded panel mask is also recalculated with radius 24
Re-enabling floating restores dock surface height to 108px for the 8px screen-edge margin
